snippet.title: Heartworm | Available Now!
snippet.description:
Look alive. Heartworm, Vincent Adinolfi and his team’s love letter to the golden age of low-poly survival horror, is OUT NOW! As grief blurs the line between reality and the supernatural, will you be able to connect with your grandfather one last time, or will you succumb to the horrors locked away in the mountains?

Just remember to be kind and rewind. 

Store link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1257030/Heartworm/
Follow the dev: https://x.com/adinolfi
Join the official DreadXP community: https://discord.gg/PX25QrbGrw
